faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MEA Consultant (Audit) post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Consultant (Audit) position at the Ministry of External Affairs is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Consultant (Audit) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Consultant (Audit) post in the IFD at the Ministry of External Affairs.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Consultant (Audit) role?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates in any discipline and retired Government of India officials from pay level 10 or above with experience in financial and audit matters.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Consultant (Audit) position is 63 years.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply by sending their complete application along with required documents via email to the address specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Consultant (Audit) position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Consultant (Audit) position is contractual.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection process steps?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Interview, Written Test, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) is conducting this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
